scope: Actual Campaign backend dispatch, job completion, construction snapshot and reload initializer in native API VM fixtures only. Exact delivery APK gameplay checks are separate.

checks.name: Cancelling a future site removes only that journal immediately while the same workers continue the active structure
Cancelling active construction keeps its actual unfinished native foundation and existing STOP semantics
Cancellation preserves other workers, FIFO positions, unrelated native-only journals and exact job-ID matching
Saved cancelled state reloads through the actual GameLoaded initializer without restoring a removed blueprint or issuing its order
Cancelled plans cannot capture a later foundation at the same coordinates, while the new job journal binds it
Done and blocked jobs retain their existing journals; cancellation is the only changed terminal path
Existing Stop override cancellation drops only app journals while preserving all native structures
